note: Reference: the cloth robe's menu, raised on both apps by the same bridge command with the robe in the pack. The five header leaves are quoted RELATIVE to each app's own popup top line (see `anchor`), because they are about the header's CONTENT -- with absolute rects they also silently scored the popup's PLACEMENT, and Raves' popup sits a constant 16px lower, which made a pixel-accurate header read as broken. That offset is now its own leaf, popup_placement.

controls_note: fixture_dependent says whether a leaf changes when a DIFFERENT item's popup is scored. It is recorded per leaf because the distinction was already got wrong once on the Equipment spec, where list_cat/list_item were treated as chrome and are not. Only the two leaves with fixture_dependent=false -- popup_image_frame and popup_placement -- are safe as CONTROLS when validating a retaken baseline; everything else moves with the item and would mask a real regression. That is a thin control set, which is exactly why the pin must name the item.

qud_model.measured: 2026-08-08, from Qud's LIVE RectTransforms via the mod's `uiprobe` (target=PopupMessage) plus the committed captures. Both agree: the probe's MenuControll h=407.12 against 407.5 measured between the chrome rules.
qud_model.root: PopupMessage 1920x1080, VerticalLayoutGroup, align=MiddleCenter, no padding -- Qud CENTRES the popup, it does not place it at a fixed y
qud_model.popup_box: MenuControll x=820.9 y=336.44 w=278.21 h=407.12, VerticalLayoutGroup spacing=10 pad L20 R20 T0 B5, UpperLeft. y is exactly (1080-407.12)/2
qud_model.header_block: ContextContainer h=138.12, VerticalLayoutGroup spacing=10 pad T10, MiddleCenter
qud_model.name_line: ContextItemText x=840.9 y=428.44 w=238.21 h=20.12 -- full content width, so the name is centred on x=960.0, exactly screen centre
qud_model.divider: 'polat frame reverse header' h=16 at y=458.56
qud_model.command_area: Scroll View h=224; Content spacing=2 pad L5 R5; options area h=222 spacing=2
qud_model.header_block_arithmetic: VERIFIED to the pixel against the probe's own numbers: ContextContainer = padT(10) + tile(72) + spacing(10) + nameLine(20.12) + spacing(10) + divider(16) = 138.12, and the probe reports h=138.12. MenuControll's y is likewise exactly (1080-407.12)/2 = 336.44. So the vertical model is fully derived, not fitted.
qud_model.chrome_vs_box: THE PART THAT MAKES THIS A REWORK, not a margin tweak. Qud's visible rules do not bound the centred box: the top rule (320) sits 16.44 ABOVE MenuControll's top, and the bottom rule (728) sits 15.56 INSIDE its bottom (743.56). Raves instead draws its top rule 8px INSIDE the panel (`_draw_chrome`, ly=8) and centres the PANEL. Landing Qud's rules therefore means changing which box is centred and where the chrome hangs off it -- panel_h would have to go 424 -> 456 and the bottom rule from 17 to 40 above the panel bottom -- for every popup kind that shares this panel (message, yes/no, menu, input, picker), not just the item popup.

offsets_note:
THE '16px LOW' IS NOT A CONSTANT, and must not be fixed with one. Decomposed 2026-08-08 by measuring the three chrome rules in both apps (qud 320/471.5/728, raves 336/487.5/735):
  header block  151.0 vs 151.0  -- ALREADY EXACT, Raves' header is Qud's model
  command area  256.5 vs 247.5  -- Raves is 9px SHORT, and this part scales with the number of options, so it is not a fixed error
  centre        524.2 vs 535.8  -- Raves' box sits 11.5px lower, i.e. a different anchoring
  width         278.21 vs ~280  -- Raves is 2px wider
Adding 16 to the popup's y would zero the TOP rule on this one capture and leave the BOTTOM rule 7px out, because the observed 16 is the sum of a content-dependent height error and an anchoring error that happen to add up on the cloth robe's 5-option menu. The 2026-08-05 note that it was 'constant across a 5- and a 7-option menu' is not evidence of a fixed offset -- both parts can be near-constant while the sum is a coincidence of those two sizes.
The 1px name-line offset is very likely a consequence of the 2px width difference (Qud centres the name on x=960.0 exactly; a 2px-wider box centred the same way rounds differently), so it should be re-measured AFTER the box model is right rather than nudged on its own.
Fix = port Qud's box model whole (the `qud_model` block above), per the repo's own precedent: the ability bar only went 13.5 -> 4.0 when Qud's cell model was applied WHOLE, and every piecemeal copy scored WORSE. NOT DONE as of 2026-08-08; the model is recorded here so the port starts from numbers rather than from a delta.

2026-08-08, second pass: the vertical model is now DERIVED and confirmed (see qud_model.header_block_arithmetic), and Raves' anchor identified (see qud_model.chrome_vs_box). The port was still not landed, and the reason is scope rather than knowledge: it changes which box is centred for every popup kind, and the verification that would make it trustworthy -- several option counts AND several popup kinds -- is the same verification that would catch a half-port. Landing it unverified is the ability-bar failure mode, where each piecemeal copy scored worse than doing nothing.
